# 50agents

> Apps, AI agents, and automations built around how your business works. 2,300+ app integrations via viaSocket.

## Agent interfaces

- [MCP (Streamable HTTP)](https://50agents.com/mcp): Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint for agent tools.
- [Plugins API](https://50agents.com/api/plugins): Public agent template catalog (GET).
- [Mushrooms](https://mushroom.viasocket.com/): Full app integrations catalog on viaSocket.
- [OpenAPI](https://50agents.com/openapi.json): OpenAPI description of public site HTTP APIs.

## Docs

- [Help Center](https://50agents.com/help): Product documentation, policies, and how-to guides.
- [Getting Started — Meeting Agent](https://50agents.com/help/meeting-agent): Set up the AI meeting recorder.

## Product

- [Home](https://50agents.com/): Positioning, capabilities, and getting started.
- [AI Agents](https://50agents.com/ai-agents): Browse and deploy AI agents for apps.
- [Agent Templates](https://50agents.com/templates): Pre-built agent templates to start from.
- [Work Management](https://50agents.com/work-management): Tasks, workflows, and team work.
- [AI Meeting Recorder](https://50agents.com/ai-note-taker): Record meetings and generate notes.
- [Pricing](https://50agents.com/pricing): Plans and pricing.

## API

- [Plugins](https://50agents.com/api/plugins): List available AI agent plugins.
- [Plugin search](https://50agents.com/api/plugins/search): Search the plugin catalog.
- [Plugin categories](https://50agents.com/api/plugins/categories): Plugin category listing.
- [Prompts](https://50agents.com/api/prompts): Sample prompts surfaced on the marketing site.
- [Page metadata](https://50agents.com/api/meta): SEO metadata for site routes.
- [FAQs](https://50agents.com/api/FAQs): FAQ content for site pages.
